args.body: Use the existing November 27 parser-parity checkpoint and the last verified live release binding. Before the recorded cutoff, identify the aggregate evidence that covers the window. At or after the cutoff, reconcile once and reuse any equivalent verdict. Report eligible requests, delivery, orders and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve unknown counts wherever classifier or attribution coverage is incomplete. Use permitted aggregate or redacted evidence and keep private correspondence outside public tasks.

Before offering the lab, tie redistribution rights to the exact archive and require readable seller terms for whichever checkout channel is used.
